spec_match.rationale: Models the spec's actual object graph (audio elements, mix presentations with sub-mix gains, authored loudness layouts, language annotations) and implements the section 7.3.1 selection guidance with an explicit what-is-real-what-is-model banner, since browsers expose no parsed-OBU surface.

interactive.rationale: Layout and language selects drive the selection, highlight the winning mix presentation card, render the decoder-output chain, and print a per-candidate reason trace; a second button runs the real decodingInfo probe.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the selection walkthrough plus the real probe; both are on the page and labelled as model vs real.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers language-mismatch fallback, no-authored-layout fallback with renderer conversion per 7.3.2, and the binaural/headphones path; the probe handles missing mediaCapabilities and rejection separately.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, spec section 7.3.1 anchor, and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: The probe half rests on the suite's resolve-not-reject and surface-agreement assertions; the model half is explicitly non-probeable and not claimed by any assertion; suite 8/8 in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven headless Chromium 141 exercised four layout/language combinations (MP1 stereo/en, MP2 5.1.4/en, MP3 binaural/es, MP3 5.1/es via richest-fallback with renderer-converts reason) and the real probe (honest supported:false); console/network clean; desktop and mobile screenshots read, selected-card highlight verified visually.

telemetry_health.rationale: iamf-mix-selection-ran asserts each selection with layout/lang/winner; the probe asserts iamf-explorer-probe-ran on answers and its own fallback id when mediaCapabilities is missing.

design_system.rationale: All colours from variables; the selected card uses an accent-blue inline-start border on bg-paper with black text (AA); buttons keep the global dark style.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects, the decoder-output box is aria-live=polite, the trace is a role=status region, and selection is conveyed in text ('— SELECTED' plus the reason line), not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Columns stack via auto-fit minmax; measured scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 DPR3; desktop verified via responsive-check with the three-column layout intact.

openQuestions.title: Tighten the selection model against 7.3.1 normative text
openQuestions.detail: The page implements the informative selection guidance (language annotations, authored loudness layouts, renderer fallback) transparently, but 7.3.1 also discusses ranked loudness layouts within a mix presentation. If a future reading shows a materially different ranking rule, refine the trace wording — the current copy already labels the logic as guidance, so this is copy-precision, not honesty.

guidanceConsulted.query: async feature detection status updates aria live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Convey selection state in text and announce grouped async output via polite live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Winning card is marked in its accessible name text, the decoder-output box is aria-live=polite, and the trace is role=status.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP DOM: '.mp-card.selected .name' contains '— SELECTED' for all four tested combinations

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table matrix mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Multi-column explainer layouts should be auto-fit grids that collapse to a single column on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The three-column model uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)) and stacks at 360px with no horizontal overflow (measured scrollWidth 360).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP measurement: mix-presentation-explorer scrollW=360 at 360x740 DPR3

summary: Novel/advanced angle: the mix-presentation model that makes IAMF more than a codec, as an interactive worked example of section 7.3.1 selection with an honest model-vs-real boundary and a real decodingInfo probe for the modelled sequence. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141 (sanctioned cloud fallback) across four layout/language combinations plus the probe; clean console/network; both device classes screenshotted.
